name: The Caesars
scope: Yes if it is a Roman or Byzantine emperor coming to the throne
boundary: The Caesars owns each emperor's accession; every other moment of the Roman state stays in The Roman Story.
example_beats: Vespasian ends the Year of Four Emperors (69)
notes: One beat per emperor, dated to his accession, from Augustus to the fall of Constantinople. Prefer the famous, and give Byzantium its share.
